column1: # memfn/data/cards/kit-grid.tsv — THE KIT'S METHOD CARDS, `kit-grid@N` (R-MS5;
# docs/design/measure_sets.md §7.2; r17b_prime.md §5.2). One row per
# (owner, quantity, ver), APPEND-ONLY by version: a committed row never
# changes. `ver 1` is grid1's method (the run zen4-grid1, gridread @
# 540649453: docs/dev/lanes/grid1_report.md, gridread_report.md), the method
# every row of the interim set kit-interim-grid1 was measured under. `ver 2`
# (grid2's: the dispatch charges, the one-byte libc rows, NONE, the pre-scan
# gate, the mode branch, M16-M24) is grid2's prep lane's, NOT written here.
# `ver 3` is span_pick stage 2's (docs/design/memfn/span_cards.md §2.4, unit
# S2c): the four cards zen4-grid3 is measured under (find_byte, find_hit,
# verify_cmp, enter), each timed arm the form's canonical instance rendered
# by formhash.c's entry table (§3.2).
# Columns (measure_sets.md §7.2): owner quantity ver dims unit subject
# lengths launches rounds aa_rule gate_e6 env deps.
#   dims     the key's dimension names in order (§1.3): a key
#            `kit.<quantity>.<t1>...` has exactly this many tokens
#   unit     ratio (to the version's u, or a dimensionless ratio), walkbytes
#            (cost in u.B), bytes. u per version: ver 1 u = beta_walk(DFA_SCAN,
#            r1e0c0) = 0.1892 ns/B; ver 3 u = find_byte.walk (span_cards.md
#   lengths  ver 1: the lengths measured, in prose. ver 3: the row's
#            ESTIMATOR in the spec's grammar (measures.md §3.4), integers
#            only: `slope X1,X2,X3` (the per-byte slope over those call
#            lengths) or `delta LEN` (the arm minus its base arm at length
#            LEN, the base named on the row's own cells, never here)
#   aa_rule  the A/A design: ver 1 `pair-per-group`; ver 3 `twin-per-arm`
#            (every timed arm has its own A/A twin, an independent placement
#            in the same launch) and, on the unit's card, `bimodal-test`
#            (measure_sets.md §1.4), `;`-joined
#   gate_e6  the group's refusal gate: UNMEASURED DEFAULT (D149) until derived
#            from committed sets (§7.3); `-` where the row is derived. ver 3
#            states `-`: its gate is the kit policy table's gate_default_e6
#            (../policy.tsv, R-35 (e), review r9 SLOT-17), one home; a set
#            carries the card as declared (`-`, check C) and the producer's
#            run record pins the value it took (span_cards.md §2.4, r9fc
#            FIX-8)
#   env      the method's declared safe direction (`-` until M2, R-MS4)
#   deps     the dependency ids the producer hashes (§2.4): kit:form.<id>
#            (mf_form_hash; `walk`, `libc` render at B1, V1 at B4, S1/A1
#            (the W64 rows) at B6: tests/memfn/run_finder.sh lists the
#            unresolved as OWED, never as a pass). ver 3 lists its form ids
#            (formhash.c's entry table; `walk-set` folded into `walk`, its
#            site text being the walk's): a row records
#            `kit:form.<its form token>=<hash>` (span_cards.md §2.4). A card
#            naming a kit:form. dep has `form` as its FIRST dim
#            (finder_check.py check C)
# `ver 4` is K38-3's step-back cell (docs/design/memfn/span_runs_sheet.md §5.2):
# the one card `enter_back` (dims kind;entry;back), the `enter` quantity timed
# with the consumer entered t bytes before the window, t in {0, 3, 8, 16, 32}
# (the `back` dim). A NEW ver, not a ver-3 row: ver 3 is CLOSED (measure_store/
# zen4-grid3/1 pins kit-grid@3's whole card list, check C's check_store compares
# it). The cell is PLANNED (span_cards/slot/plan.py, J5) and visibly UNMEASURED:
# no set exists under ver 4; its measurement is a timing run in an owner-cleared
# window. Subject, estimator, launches, rounds and A/A are `enter`'s.
# `ver 5` is R-38 Part D's scan-less body (docs/design/memfn/part_d.md rev 4
# §5.3 [r2pd P9], [r3pd FIX-5]): the one card `every_pos`, the offset-skip
# function's `fn-every-pos` BODY (no find: every candidate position runs the
# verify chain), per byte of subject, its form the formhash.c instance
# `every-pos` (a REQUIRED run of two wide positions, P0's scan-less reply).
# UNMEASURED: no set holds a `kit.every_pos.*` row and no box has run this
# card; every reader skips an absent key (the kit-kernels@1 precedent).
# Nothing prices it (no pricing reads cards yet), so UNMEASURED moves no byte.
# Subject, estimator, launches, rounds and A/A are find_byte's.
# `ver 6` is the INLINE ONE-MEMBER FINDER's (lane mfind; D190's search piece
# with the MASK stream, memfn/src/vrun.c): the two cards `find_byte` and
# `find_hit`, find_byte's and find_hit's method (subject, estimator,
# launches, rounds, A/A) on ONE offset-skip site, its forms the formhash.c
# instances `mfind-swar` (SIMD-off, the SWAR word), `mfind-w16`, `mfind-w32`
# (the levels) and `fn-memchr`, the SAME site's libc memchr search (and its
# restart stream). This is the BUNDLE comparison (review 2026-11-15 r2 F6):
# a ver-6 delta names the call boundary, own code vs library, the search and
# the stream together, as one; the ruled single-piece cells (SEARCH vs the
# walk, STREAM RESTART vs MASK, D190) are not built: owed ONLY on a D197 WIN
# at a level, under their own go. A new ver: ver 3 is CLOSED. UNMEASURED: no set holds a ver-6 row
# and no box has run it. The row is an UNPICKED MEASURING INSTRUMENT (D197,
# Frank 2026-11-15), never a pick: it is reached only by the test-only lever
# `mfind`, so UNMEASURED moves no byte. Its timing is the
# slot harness's mfcard window (jobs JMB/JMH, decided per ISA level by
# slot/d197_rule.tsv); what else stays open (the mfind-w64 arm, the entry
# cut-over default, the row floors) is listed in span_cards.md §2.7. The
# timing sees one site, NOT the artifact's size (the lever text is 2.9x-6x
# fn-memchr's body): the emitted size is reported beside each row, never in
# its value. Lane slotx gave find_hit@6 a fifth dim
# while the row was still a draft of its lane chain (when a card row binds:
# docs/design/measure_sets.md §7.2), `reject`: the percent of planted hits the site's check rejects
# (the site's run is two bytes, `xy`; a rejected hit lacks its `y`), so the
# MASK stream's continue-after-reject path is timed, not only accepted
# hits; the slot plans the card as jobs JMB/JMH (slot/plan.py).
# `ver 7` is the SPAN FORMS' cards C1-C5 (lane forms, R-45 plan A; docs/design/memfn/r45_reply.md
# rev 6 §3 "The cards"): I (the deny `no-span-loop`) and H(h) for every finite grid head h in
# {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 64} (0 = L), set through the test-only lever `span-head=N`, on ONE
# frozen binary. WHOLE-ARTIFACT cells (pcrec's artifact + one find-all, as J5's `enter`), so no
# card names a kit:form. dep. dims: `form` (I, h<N>, engine), `pat` (the card's pattern id),
# `regime` (hit-dense, near-miss, not-warm, miss-heavy, short-subject, random), `layer` (off,
# on). Unit: ratio to I's time in the same (pat, regime, layer) cell (raw medians, ns per subject
# byte, 1 MiB subject); C4 is bytes (emitted C, `.text`), no timing; C5 the engine route
# (`--memfn=no-window-search`) over I. `lengths` `-`: one call length (the 1 MiB subject), no
# estimator. `aa_rule` `aa-cell`: the floor f is read from the lit-l16 A/A pair over every regime
# read and both layers, SIZED TO THE RULE'S COMPARISON COUNT (r45_reply.md rev 7 §3 "The floor
# `f`": exp(z(0.05 / N) x the A/A sigma's upper bound) - 1, never below the largest A/A ratio). The script, its dry run, R0-R5 and the identity check:
# memfn/tests/span_forms/cards.py. UNMEASURED: no set holds a ver-7 row and no box has run it;
# the regimes `not-warm` and `short-subject` are the kit's approximations until the bench names
# its methods (D198 (f), its `short-subject-search` subject), and their cells are VOID BY METHOD
# until then (rev 7 §3). The design names kit-synthetic.tsv
# for these rows; they live here because kit-synthetic's cards are the synthetic sets', "never
# measured" (its header), and these are measured method cards (lane forms report, Cards).
# `ver 8` is the VECTOR SPAN's card C6 `span_vector` (R-47 U5, docs/design/memfn/block_span.md §8): on
# ONE pcrec binary at `-fmemfn-simd=x86-64-v3`, the arm V (the default compile: the wrapper, the `w32`
# block) against the arm H64@on (`--memfn=no-span-vector`: the wrapper, the body and the TU's header and
# stamps change together, timed together on purpose: G-3 is what the caller gets). WHOLE-ARTIFACT cells,
# `form` (V, H64, H64.b: the A/A arm, the deny's text timed as a third arm on its OWN layout pool), `pat` (a
# C6 pattern id; its width is stated per pattern in cards.py), `regime` (the six of ver 7 plus near-miss-in at
# the window sites with k + 1 <= 255; the cuts are named in the rule), `layer` (`on` for C6; C6c, the
# compiler-axis card, `off-clang` and `off-os`: the SIMD-off layer under clang -O2 and gcc -Os, rows of
# cards.py's layer table). Unit: ratio of V's median ns per subject byte to H64's in the same (pat, regime,
# layer) cell. `lengths` `-` and `aa_rule` `aa-cell` as ver 7, with the A/A arm per pattern in the card
# itself. THE RULE is the committed memfn/tests/span_forms/c6_rule.md (adapting job 710's, rule_710.md,
# clause by clause; review r79): its sha, computed from the file, heads every result (its RECORD clause); a
# standing A/A non-TIE rate above its threshold VOIDS a box's verdict. `deps` kit:form.span-vector:
# formhash.c's WINDOW shape at k >= 1, three instances (b16 k 31 and b32 k 40 at x86-64-v3, off k 31 at no
# level: every rendering the cards time), so a change of V's text stales the row. UNMEASURED: no set
# holds a ver-8 row and no box has run it; V is CANDIDATE until C6 has run on every bench box that runs it
# (block_span.md §8, D155 item 2). The SIMD-off wrapper under gcc -O2 is not timed (r68 F-14; U2b's census
# is its record); C6c times it under clang -O2 and gcc -Os for [BSPAN-CLANG-DIFF] (it gates nothing).
# Divergence recorded (fdb1_report.md F-B1-6): r17b_prime.md §5.2's card table

# `kit.gstar.<liner>.<kind>` (two tokens). The card follows the READER; a
# shape split, if grid2 measures one, is a ver bump and a row edit.
